ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-a1.prompt: $ABC$ is an isosceles triangle, with angles $\angle A=3x^\circ$ and $\angle B=\angle C=x^\circ$ as shown. Find the value of $x$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-a2.prompt: Let $T=36$. The curve with equation $y=x^2+x$ cuts the line with equation $y=2x+\sqrt T$ at two points. Find the sum of the $y$ co-ordinates of these points.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-a3.prompt: Let $T=14$. The length of a rectangle is $3$ cm more than its width. The perimeter of the rectangle is $3T$ cm. The length of a second rectangle is $2$ cm more than its width. The perimeter of this rectangle is $(T+10)$ cm. The difference in the areas of these rectangles is $k\ \text{cm}^2$. Find $k$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-a4.prompt: Let $T=73$. The operation $\diamond$ is defined by $a\diamond b=\dfrac{a+b+ab}{a+b}$. The value of $\left(\dfrac{T-3}{10}\right)\diamond(6\diamond3)$ is $\dfrac pq$, where $p$ and $q$ are positive integers with no common factor other than $1$. Find $p-q$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-b1.prompt: The volume of a cylinder with radius $12$ cm and height $6$ cm is $k$ times the volume of a cone with radius $6$ cm and height $12$ cm. Find $k$. (The volume of a cylinder is $\pi r^2h$ and of a cone is $\frac13\pi r^2h$.)

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-b2.prompt: Let $T=6$. The equation $x^2+(T-1)x-T=0$ has solutions $x=a$ and $x=b$, where $a<b$. Find $a$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-b3.prompt: Let $T=-6$. A rectangle has sides of length $(11+T)$ cm and $(7-T)$ cm. The area of the rectangle is $A\ \text{cm}^2$ and the perimeter is $P$ cm. Find $A-P$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-b4.prompt: Let $T=29$. $T$ can be written as $a^2+b^2$, where $a$ and $b$ are positive integers with $a>b$. Let $K=(a+b)^3-(a-b)^3$. Find $K$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-c1.prompt: $Y$ is inversely proportional to $X^2$. $Y=36$ when $X=8$. Find the value of $Y$ when $X=16$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-c2.prompt:
Let $T=9$. The frequency table for a variable $x$ is shown below.

| $x$ | $2$ | $4$ | $6$ | $8$ | $10$ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| frequency | $T+3$ | $T$ | $2T-7$ | $T\div3$ | $T-4$ |

The mean value of $x$ is $m$. Find $m$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-c3.prompt: Let $T=5$. The sum of the interior angles of a regular polygon is $10(2T-1)(3T+1)$ degrees. Find the number of sides of this polygon.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-c4.prompt: Let $T=10$. A bag contains $T-4$ red counters and $T-6$ blue counters. Four counters are withdrawn at random, one after another, without replacement. $p$ is the probability that exactly three of the withdrawn counters are red; $q$ is the probability that exactly two are red. The ratio $p:q$ may be written in the form $a:a+1$, with $a>0$. Find $a$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-d1.prompt: The equation $x^2+15x-3136=0$ can also be written as $(x-a^2)(x+b^2)=0$, where $a$ and $b$ are positive integers. Find the value of $b^2$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-d2.prompt: Let $T=64$. A bag contains $10$ counters. There are $\left(\dfrac{T-4}{10}\right)$ red counters in the bag. All the other counters in the bag are blue. Three counters are removed at random without being replaced. The probability of there being exactly two counters of the same colour among the three that have been removed is $\dfrac ab$, where $a$ and $b$ are positive integers with no common factor other than $1$. Find $a+b-1$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-d3.prompt: Let $T=8$. The decagon shown has rotational symmetry of order $5$. The size of angle $BCD$ is $4T^\circ$. The obtuse angle $ABC$ is $x^\circ$. Find the sum of the digits of $x$.

ukmt-stmc-2018-19-regional-shuttle-d4.prompt: Let $T=5$. The simultaneous equations $x^2+6xy+9y^2=49$ and $x^2+4xy+4y^2=T^2$ have four pairs of solutions. $n$ is the sum of the two positive values of $x$ that occur in these solutions. Find $n$.
